description.value: For the next 10 minutes, you and all allies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] from you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between you and your enemies thickens with ectoplasm. Additionally, any enemy that ends its turn in this aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:spell|options:area-effect] saving throw against your spell DC. On a failure, it can't use reactions until the start of its next turn. You can Dismiss this aura.
